title: RAG agent repeated damaged-item retrieval output

messages.content: You are a retrieval-augmented support agent using a synthetic knowledge base. Cite retained demo documents and avoid private data.
Draft a safe answer for a synthetic customer whose package was marked damaged in transit and who asks whether a refund is available.
I will retrieve the demo policy documents for damaged items, refund windows, and escalation criteria.

retriever.search(query="refund window damaged item", top_k=5, corpus="demo_knowledge_base")

1. doc_id=kb_demo_returns_014 score=0.918 title="Returns and refunds for damaged items"
   snippet="Customers may request a refund or replacement for damaged items within 30 days of delivery. Ask for photos only when the damage is not already verified by carrier scan."
   source=synthetic_help_center updated=2026-04-17

2. doc_id=kb_demo_returns_021 score=0.884 title="Carrier-confirmed damage workflow"
   snippet="When carrier scan status is DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT, support agents can offer refund, replacement, or store credit without asking the customer to repeat evidence already in the shipment record."
   source=synthetic_help_center updated=2026-04-18

3. doc_id=kb_demo_policy_009 score=0.842 title="Refund method timing"
   snippet="Refunds to the original payment method are initiated immediately after approval and usually appear in 5 to 7 business days depending on the issuing bank."
   source=synthetic_policy_manual updated=2026-03-22

4. doc_id=kb_demo_macro_032 score=0.805 title="Macro: damaged item apology"
   snippet="Acknowledge the issue, avoid blaming the carrier, summarize the resolution choice, and provide timing. Do not include private account data in the reply."
   source=synthetic_macro_library updated=2026-05-02

5. doc_id=kb_demo_escalation_006 score=0.762 title="When to escalate damaged delivery cases"
   snippet="Escalate only when the order value exceeds the synthetic demo threshold, the address is disputed, or the customer requests a manager review."
   source=synthetic_policy_manual updated=2026-02-10
